facts.fact: MyBroadband reports Teraco says its South African data centres let enterprises interconnect directly to cloud on-ramps (Azure, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Google Cloud, Huawei Cloud, Oracle) and to cable landings, with over 29,500 interconnects.
Teraco says NAPAfrica's peak traffic is now over 7Tbps, up from 6Tbps a year earlier, with more than 690 connected networks.

Teraco says its facilities give direct interconnect access to subsea cables landing in South Africa, including 2Africa, ACE, EASSy, Equiano, METISS, SACS, SAT3/SAFE, Seacom and WACS; landing stations are not named.
facts.system: Subsea cables landing in South Africa

ZAF.note: Foreign networks peering at NAPAfrica is commercial use, no arrangement stated.
Only LEO connectivity nodes hosted; no licence or sale to customers stated.
